text: A redesigned onboarding that looks like the rest of the app, in three clear steps, with a step list on large screens. When a bot cannot start you now get a readable reason (hosting busy, platform updating, rejected configuration, or free hosting time to earn from the mobile app) instead of a raw error, and a banner tells you when your latest changes could not be synced. Switching a bot's engine lists what will be left out. JavaScript bots: commands, events, schedules and webhooks created in Studio now run, and one malformed item no longer blocks the whole bot from starting. The AI Copilot now writes in your bot's own language (JavaScript, or BDFD and blocks), answers and summaries follow the language you write in, a failed reply gives your text back, and continuing a conversation no longer creates duplicate chats that spend credits. Fixed: a failed start no longer uses up your bot quota.
